title: MicroSDF: Microfacet-Driven Hybrid Neural SDFs for Mixed-Reflectance Surface Reconstruction
title_zh: MicroSDF：基于微面理论的混合神经SDF，用于混合反射率表面重建

paragraphs.en: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: ( i ) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; ( ii ) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and ( iii ) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: 3D surface reconstruction aims to recover the geometry of a scene from 2D images, enabling downstream tasks such as novel view synthesis and scene understanding. It is a fundamental task in computer vision [ 1 ] , with widespread applications in robotics, autonomous navigation, and augmented reality. Real-world scenes often contain a mixture of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, coexisting within the same environment. However, most existing methods are designed to handle either diffuse (non-reflective) [ 2 , 3 ] , or highly reflective surfaces [ 4 ] , independently. This limits their generalization in mixed scenes, reducing their robustness in practical applications. To achieve high-fidelity and reliable reconstruction in diverse real-world scenarios, a unified framework that adaptively models both surface types is essential.

paragraphs.en: Current reconstruction paradigms face significant limitations when applied to reflective surfaces. For example, traditional Multi-View Stereo (MVS) methods rely on the assumption of multi-view consistency, which is commonly violated in reflective regions due to their strong view-dependent appearance. While recent neural implicit representations, especially neural Signed Distance Field (SDF) methods [ 3 , 7 , 8 ] , have significantly advanced 3D reconstruction, their underlying rendering formulations often neglect the physical properties of highly reflective surfaces. Consequently, these methods struggle to disentangle view-dependent appearance from true geometry in reflective regions, leading to inaccurate reconstructions.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的重建范式在应用于反射表面时面临显著的限制。 例如，传统的多视角立体（MVS）方法依赖于多视角一致性的假设，而这一假设在反射区域中通常不成立，因为这些区域的外观强烈依赖视角。 尽管近期的神经隐式表示方法，尤其是神经符号距离场（SDF）方法 [3, 7, 8]，已显著推动了三维重建的发展，但其底层的渲染公式往往忽略了高反射表面的物理特性。 因此，这些方法难以在反射区域中将视角依赖的外观与真实几何结构区分开来，从而导致重建结果不准确。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty of handling reflective surfaces is also encountered in inverse rendering, which aims to infer the scene’s geometry, material properties, and lighting from observed images. This is, however, fundamentally ill-posed: multiple combinations of material parameters, lighting, and shape can produce the same observed color, making decomposition from color supervision solely inherently ambiguous [ 9 , 4 , 10 ] . To address this, recent inverse rendering approaches [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] have incorporated physically grounded reflectance models, enabling more plausible and interpretable rendering results. While our goal differs, these advances raise a natural question: can physical principles be similarly integrated into neural implicit reconstruction frameworks to better handle reflective surfaces? Inspired by this, we turn to microfacet theory [ 14 ] , a foundational model in graphics that captures surface reflectance behavior through statistical distributions of microscopic surface normals. A key insight from this theory is the distinction between reflective and non-reflective regions: specular regions exhibit small variance in microfacet normals, while non-specular regions show large variance.
paragraphs.zh: 在处理反射表面时遇到的困难也存在于逆渲染中，其目标是根据观测到的图像推断场景的几何结构、材料属性和光照。 然而，这个问题在根本上是病态的：多种材料参数、光照和形状的组合都可能产生相同的观测颜色，因此仅通过颜色监督进行分解本质上具有歧义 [ 9 , 4 , 10 ] 。 为了解决这一问题，近期的逆渲染方法 [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] 引入了基于物理的反射率模型，从而实现了更合理且更具可解释性的渲染结果。 尽管我们的目标有所不同，但这些进展引发了一个自然的问题：是否可以将物理原理以类似方式整合到神经隐式重建框架中，以更好地处理反射表面？ 受此启发，我们转向了微面理论 [ 14 ] ，这是计算机图形学中的一个基础模型，通过微观表面法线的统计分布来描述表面的反射行为。 该理论的一个关键见解在于区分了反射区域和非反射区域：镜面反射区域的微面法线方差较小，而非镜面反射区域的微面法线方差则较大。

paragraphs.en: Building upon this insight, we propose MicroSDF, a unified neural SDF framework that explicitly embeds microfacet-inspired priors into the reconstruction process, for handling both reflective and non reflective surfaces. It inherits the coarse-to-fine learning paradigm of recent neural SDF methods [ 8 , 15 , 7 , 3 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 4 ] , with sequential geometry and color networks. More specifically, MicroSDF introduces three key innovations: ( i ) Microfacet-guided geometry modeling . We sample local surface normals from a finer-scale geometry hierarchy around each query point and concatenate them with the numerical normal at the current level. To ensure physically consistent reflectance behavior, we introduce a microfacet normal consistency loss that encourages alignment between the microfacet normals and local surface normal in reflective regions, enabling coherent reflection directions. ( ii ) Microfacet-driven color modeling . We employ a dual-branch color network, as illustrated in Fig. 1 , in contrast to prior methods [ 5 , 6 ] , our specular branch incorporates microfacet normals as additional inputs to model high-frequency reflective behavior, and the vanilla branch uses the reflection direction as input to better capture diffuse and low-frequency reflective effects. This design ensures that these two branches focus on complementary aspects of color modeling. ( iii ) Detection-guided color blending . While the specular branch enables reflectance modeling, correctly identifying where to apply it remains challenging. Prior works [ 5 ] have used implicitly learned blending weights from an auxiliary MLP, which often fail to reliably identify specular highlights from true geometry. In contrast, we propose a detection-guided blending module that leverages per-pixel specular likelihoods from a pretrained detector ( e.g. , StableDelight [ 19 ] ) to guide the fusion of color predictions from the two branches. This enables physically intuitive color blending, reducing artifacts and improving reconstruction robustness across mixed-material scenes.

paragraphs.en: Multi-view stereo (MVS) aims to reconstruct fine-grained scene geometry from multi-view images. Traditional MVS methods can be classified into four categories based on the output scene representation: volumetric-based methods, mesh-based methods, point cloud-based methods, and depth map-based methods [ 20 ] . Among them, depth map-based methods [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] are the most flexible, estimating depth maps for each view by utilizing photometric consistency between reference and neighboring images, then fusing all the depth maps into dense point clouds. A typical example is COLMAP [ 21 , 22 ] , which employs a robust patch-based matching strategy to estimate depth maps and then fuses them into a complete point cloud representation. Surface reconstruction methods, such as screened Poisson Surface Reconstruction [ 25 ] , are then employed to reconstruct surfaces from the point clouds.
paragraphs.zh: 多视角立体视觉（MVS）旨在通过多视角图像重建精细的场景几何结构。 传统的 MVS 方法可根据其输出的场景表示形式分为四类：基于体素的方法、基于网格的方法、基于点云的方法和基于深度图的方法 [ 20 ] 。 其中，基于深度图的方法 [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] 最为灵活，它们利用参考图像与相邻图像之间的光度一致性来估计每个视角的深度图，然后将所有深度图融合成密集点云。 一个典型的例子是 COLMAP [ 21 , 22 ] ，它采用稳健的基于块的匹配策略来估计深度图，随后将其融合为完整的点云表示。 接着，表面重建方法（例如筛选泊松表面重建法 [ 25 ] ）被用于从点云中重建表面。

paragraphs.en: The advent of deep learning has transformed MVS by leveraging data-driven techniques for feature extraction and depth estimation. MVSNet [ 26 ] pioneered deep learning in MVS by using CNNs to construct 3D cost volumes and regress depth maps. Inspired by MVSNet, a series of outstanding works have emerged [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] . MVSNet++ [ 27 ] improved upon MVSNet by introducing feature pyramid structures and instance normalization, fusing multi-level information for accurate 3D point localization and generating smooth depth maps through tailored loss functions and a curriculum learning framework. Subsequent works like RA-MVSNet [ 28 ] and ET-MVSNet [ 29 ] enhanced accuracy through recurrent aggregation and epipolar constraints, while GeoMVSNet [ 32 ] incorporated geometric priors for better depth prediction. NR-MVSNet [ 30 ] further refined the coarse-to-fine strategy with a normal consistency-based depth hypotheses module and a depth refinement module with reliable attention, producing smoother and more accurate depth maps, particularly in texture-less and repetitive-texture regions. More recently, Transformer-based methods, such as MVSFormer [ 33 ] , MVSFormer++ [ 34 ] , and EI-MVSNet [ 31 ] , have improved performance by modeling long-range view dependencies, with EI-MVSNet leveraging epipolar-guided cost volume construction and an interval-aware depth estimation module to enhance depth estimation accuracy. However, these deep learning-based MVS methods typically require large training datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 深度学习的出现通过利用数据驱动的技术进行特征提取和深度估计，彻底改变了多视角立体视觉（MVS）。 MVSNet [ 26 ] 率先在 MVS 中引入深度学习，使用卷积神经网络（CNN）构建三维代价体积并回归深度图。 受 MVSNet 的启发，一系列杰出的研究成果相继出现 [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] 。 MVSNet++ [ 27 ] 通过引入特征金字塔结构和实例归一化，改进了 MVSNet，融合多级别信息以实现精确的三维点定位，并通过定制的损失函数和课程学习框架生成平滑的深度图。 后续的研究成果，如 RA-MVSNet [ 28 ] 和 ET-MVSNet [ 29 ] ，通过循环聚合和极线约束提升了准确性，而 GeoMVSNet [ 32 ] 则引入了几何先验以获得更优的深度预测。 NR-MVSNet [ 30 ] 进一步改进了粗到精的策略，采用基于法线一致性的深度假设模块和具有可靠注意力的深度优化模块，生成了更平滑、更准确深度图，尤其是在无纹理和重复纹理区域表现突出。 近期，基于 Transformer 的方法，如 MVSFormer [ 33 ] 、MVSFormer++ [ 34 ] 和 EI-MVSNet [ 31 ] ，通过建模长距离视角依赖关系提升了性能，其中 EI-MVSNet 利用极线引导的代价体积构建和区间感知深度估计模块，增强了深度估计的准确性。 然而，这些基于深度学习的 MVS 方法通常需要大规模的训练数据集。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, representation methods such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 35 ] and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 36 ] have revolutionized traditional 3D reconstruction, advancing tasks such as novel view rendering [ 37 , 38 ] , human performance capture [ 39 ] , human pose and shape estimation [ 40 ] , object segmentation [ 41 ] and Multi-View 3D detection [ 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，神经辐射场（NeRF）[ 35 ] 和三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）[ 36 ] 等表示方法彻底改变了传统的三维重建技术，推动了新视角渲染 [ 37 , 38 ]、人类动作捕捉 [ 39 ]、人体姿态与形状估计 [ 40 ]、物体分割 [ 41 ] 和多视角三维检测 [ 42 ] 等任务的发展。

paragraphs.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 36 ] offers high rendering quality and efficiency and has been widely adopted for novel view synthesis. However, achieving accurate geometry remains challenging because it lacks an explicit surface representation, which makes reliable surface extraction and geometry-dependent downstream tasks difficult. To improve geometric fidelity, several recent methods align Gaussian primitives with the underlying surface to enable surface extraction, including 2DGS [ 43 ] , BBSplat [ 44 ] , SuGaR [ 45 ] , GOF [ 46 ] and Rade-GS [ 47 ] . However, their geometric accuracy in practice remains generally inferior to that of neural SDF based methods. Several other variants of 3D Gaussian splatting [ 48 , 49 , 50 ] have integrated domain-specific physical principles into the 3DGS framework for different objectives. For example, WaterSplatting [ 48 ] combines 3DGS with an underwater light transport model, explicitly accounting for absorption and scattering to enable fast underwater scene reconstruction. RainyGS [ 49 ] incorporates physically based raindrop and shallow-water simulations to synthesize dynamic rain effects such as water accumulation and surface waves in reconstructed scenes. LITA-GS [ 50 ] leverages Kubelka–Munk theory to introduce illumination-invariant physical priors, thereby facilitating illumination-agnostic novel view synthesis under challenging lighting conditions. In contrast to these 3DGS based methods that are tailored to specific tasks such as underwater reconstruction, rain synthesis and illumination-robust rendering, our work focuses on surface reconstruction and geometric accuracy by adopting an implicit SDF representation and employing microfacet theory as a geometric regularizer, with the explicit goal of achieving high-fidelity surfaces and accurate geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）[ 36 ]具有高质量的渲染效果和高效的性能，已被广泛用于新视角合成。 然而，实现精确的几何结构仍然具有挑战性，因为它缺乏显式的表面表示，这使得可靠的表面提取和依赖几何结构的下游任务变得困难。 为了提高几何保真度，近期的一些方法将高斯原语与底层表面对齐以实现表面提取，包括2DGS [ 43 ]、BBSplat [ 44 ]、SuGaR [ 45 ]、GOF [ 46 ]和Rade-GS [ 47 ]。 然而，这些方法在实际应用中的几何准确性通常仍低于基于神经网络的SDF方法。 其他几种3D高斯泼溅的变体方法[ 48 , 49 , 50 ]已将特定领域的物理原理整合到3DGS框架中，以实现不同的目标。 例如，WaterSplatting [ 48 ]将3DGS与水下光传输模型相结合，明确考虑了吸收和散射效应，从而实现了快速的水下场景重建。 RainyGS [ 49 ]融入了基于物理的雨滴和浅水模拟，以在重建的场景中合成动态的雨效，例如积水和水波。 LITA-GS [ 50 ]利用Kubelka–Munk理论引入了与光照无关的物理先验，从而在复杂光照条件下实现了不受光照影响的新视角合成。 与这些针对特定任务（如水下重建、雨效合成和抗光照渲染）而设计的3DGS方法不同，我们的工作通过采用隐式SDF表示并利用微面理论作为几何正则化器，专注于表面重建和几何准确性，其明确目标是实现高保真表面和精确的几何结构。

paragraphs.en: Native NeRF similarly faces geometric limitations: its reconstruction capabilities are constrained by inherent geometric-color ambiguity [ 51 , 18 ] and the limitations of volumetric density representations, resulting in imprecise surface details. To address these limitations, subsequent research [ 18 , 7 , 16 , 52 , 53 , 8 , 3 , 17 ] has explored explicit surface representations (e.g., SDF-based formulations) to achieve high-precision geometry in NeRF-based methods. Among them, VolSDF [ 16 ] introduced a significant advancement by incorporating SDF with a Laplace transform, establishing a mathematical relationship between SDF and volumetric density. This enables precise mesh extraction through Marching Cubes [ 54 ] . Building upon this, NeuralAngelo [ 7 ] has further refined the reconstruction pipeline, achieving enhanced surface fidelity and overall reconstruction quality.

paragraphs.en: Numerous studies [ 55 , 56 , 57 , 18 , 58 , 59 ] have demonstrated the potential for mutual enhancement through the integration of NeRF with traditional MVS approaches. Among these, several methods [ 18 , 58 , 59 ] have incorporated external geometric priors, such as depth maps, point clouds, and normal maps, to provide intermediate supervision for SDF-based networks, thereby improving geometric reconstruction quality. Notably, [ 18 ] identified a fundamental bias between rendered colors and geometry, and theoretically established that direct supervision of the zero-level set of SDF networks using point cloud information offers unbiased advantages and facilitates neural implicit surface learning. However, the effectiveness of these approaches heavily relies on the quality of external supervision. Both externally supervised geometric information and native NeRF techniques face challenges in reconstructing reflective surfaces, as NeRF’s view-dependent color prediction mechanism, while effective for diffuse materials, fails to accurately model the complex light interactions and view-dependent effects of reflective surfaces. Furthermore, external supervision often relies on multi-view consistency assumptions, which may not hold in real-world scenarios.

paragraphs.en: Recent research in inverse rendering [ 60 , 61 , 62 , 13 , 63 , 64 ] has increasingly embraced physics-based rendering models to address the challenge of reflectance interpretation. While these methods employ various basis functions to approximate the rendering equation, they primarily focus on improving rendering quality, without explicit investigation and evaluation of the geometry. Notably, Neural Microfacet Fields (NMF) [ 64 ] shares a similar high-level motivation with our work: both explicitly leverage microfacet-based physical modeling as priors to reduce the ambiguity of learning from images, particularly for reflective surfaces. However, NMF and our MicroSDF are designed for different primary tasks: NMF targets volumetric inverse rendering with explicit material–illumination decomposition, whereas MicroSDF focuses on high-precision geometric reconstruction. In terms of how microfacets are incorporated, NMF embeds microfacet modeling into a volumetric representation by assigning local normals and microfacet BRDF parameters to every volumetric sample along the ray, and performs surface-style Monte Carlo reflection integration to jointly recover materials and lighting and enable relighting, with geometry represented implicitly by a density field rather than an explicit SDF surface. In contrast, MicroSDF introduces microfacets only on the explicit SDF surface, defining microfacet normals at the surface that are used both as inputs to a specular branch to capture reflective appearance and as a consistency prior that regularizes surface orientation, thereby prioritizing accurate geometry recovery in scenes with mixed reflective and non-reflective regions without performing explicit material–illumination decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 逆渲染领域的近期研究 [ 60 , 61 , 62 , 13 , 63 , 64 ] 越来越多地采用基于物理的渲染模型，以应对反射率解释这一挑战。 尽管这些方法使用各种基函数来近似渲染方程，但它们主要关注提升渲染质量，而未对几何结构进行明确的探究与评估。 值得注意的是，神经微面场（NMF）[ 64 ] 与我们工作的总体动机相似：两者都明确利用基于微面的物理建模作为先验知识，以减少从图像中学习时的模糊性，尤其针对反射表面。 然而，NMF 和我们的 MicroSDF 是为不同的主要任务而设计的：NMF 的目标是体积逆渲染，并包含显式的材料-光照分解；而 MicroSDF 则专注于高精度几何重建。 在微面的整合方式上，NMF 通过将局部法线和微面 BRDF 参数分配给沿光线的每个体积采样点，将微面建模嵌入到体积表示中，并执行表面风格的蒙特卡洛反射积分，以联合恢复材料和光照并实现重照明；其几何结构由密度场隐式表示，而非显式的 SDF 表面。 相比之下，MicroSDF 仅在显式的 SDF 表面上引入微面，在表面定义微面法线，这些法线既作为镜面分支的输入以捕捉反射外观，也作为一致性先验来正则化表面朝向；因此，它优先在包含混合反射与非反射区域的场景中恢复精确几何结构，而无需执行显式的材料-光照分解。

paragraphs.en: UniSDF [ 5 ] proposed a more universal solution by introducing a dual-branch architecture to handle both reflective and non-reflective regions. However, the core idea of UniSDF remains constrained by complex lighting phenomena in real-world scenarios, such as near-field reflection, which often leads to geometric reconstructions with significant artifacts. Through three modifications illustrated in Fig. 1 , we significantly enhance its performance in such settings. More recently, AniSDF [ 6 ] attempted to develop a universal reconstruction method by leveraging a dual-granularity geometric network and physics-based encoding. In contrast, our approach maintains a single geometric network by sampling normals at different scales. Furthermore, our modifications adopt a “loosely coupled” design with existing neural implicit reconstruction paradigms, facilitating easier practical application.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce the proposed MicroSDF, a unified neural surface reconstruction framework that integrates microfacet theory to jointly model geometry and reflectance for both reflective and non-reflective surfaces. An overview of the proposed framework is illustrated in Fig. 2 . This section elaborates the overall design of our method, beginning with rendering preliminaries (Section III-A ), followed by two core components: ( i ) microfacet-guided geometry modeling (Section III-B ), which extracts physically consistent surface normals from a signed distance field, and ( ii ) microfacet-driven color modeling (Section III-C ), which employs a dual-branch network with a proposed detection-guided blending process. We also describe our multi-stage optimization strategy (Section III-D ), which enables progressive refinement and ensures physically faithful reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: Accurately modeling surface reflectance, especially specular components, requires not only capturing the overall surface shape but also accounting for fine-grained normal variations. To this end, we propose to extract dual-scale normals that compute both macroscopic and microfacet normals for each sampled 3D point. This dual-scale formulation enables our model to capture both global surface structure and fine-grained normal variations, which are critical for consistent geometry reconstruction and physically plausible specular reflection modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 要准确模拟表面反射率，尤其是镜面反射成分，不仅需要捕捉表面的整体形状，还需要考虑细微的法线变化。 为此，我们提出提取双尺度法线的方法，为每个采样的三维点同时计算宏观法线和微面法线。 这种双尺度建模方式使我们的模型能够同时捕捉全局表面结构和细微的法线变化，这对保持几何结构的一致性和实现物理上合理的镜面反射模拟至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Although the effectiveness of coarse-to-fine training has been well demonstrated, our experiments show that, with sufficient training at the initial level, certain intermediate levels can be skipped. This enables a more direct transition to the finest level, where analytical gradients can replace numerical ones for improved efficiency. Based on this insight, we propose a four-stage training strategy comprising: ( i ) geometry initialization (Geometry Init.), ( ii ) thorough training at the first level (1st Level), ( iii ) progressive coarse-to-fine processing (Coarse-to-Fine), and ( iv ) final training at the finest level (Finest Level).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管粗到细训练的有效性已得到充分证明，但我们的实验表明，只要初始阶段的训练足够充分，某些中间阶段就可以跳过。 这使得模型能够更直接地过渡到最精细的阶段，此时分析性梯度可以替代数值梯度，从而提升效率。 基于这一认识，我们提出一种包含四个阶段的训练策略：（i）几何初始化（Geometry Init.）、（ii）在第一阶段的全面训练（1st Level）、（iii）渐进式粗到细处理（Coarse-to-Fine），以及（iv）在最精细阶段的最终训练（Finest Level）。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. Following prior works [ 5 , 3 , 16 , 7 , 10 ] , we evaluate the proposed method on three widely used benchmarks: ( i ) DTU [ 75 ] : The DTU multi-view dataset contains 15 real-world scenes, each captured from 49 or 64 viewpoints with high-resolution images. Each scene contains objects with diverse materials and complex geometries, including both reflectance and non-reflectance surfaces. DTU provides ground-truth 3D models and camera trajectories, making it a standard benchmark for quantitative evaluation of point cloud reconstruction.( ii ) Shiny Blender [ 65 ] : The Shiny Blender dataset is a synthetic benchmark consisting of 6 reflective objects rendered under controlled settings. We use it to provide additional quantitative evaluation on reflective surfaces. ( iii ) Ref-NeRF [ 65 ] : The Ref-NeRF dataset is designed to evaluate reconstruction quality for reflective objects in uncontrolled real-world scenarios. It includes three challenging scenes, i.e., “sedan”, “garden spheres”, and “toycar”, each featuring multi-view images of highly reflective surfaces. Ref-NeRF specifically tests an algorithm’s robustness to specular reflections. ( iv ) DeepVoxels [ 76 ] : To evaluate performance in more realistic settings, we select two scenes (a glossy sphere and a coffee cup) from this dataset. Both scenes were captured with handheld cameras and processed via COLMAP [ 21 , 22 ] , featuring reflective surfaces under non-ideal conditions.

The first term measures how close the prediction is to the ground truth (accuracy), and the second term measures coverage of the ground truth by the prediction (completeness). paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. We implement our algorithm in PyTorch. For efficiency, we adopt the approach from [ 70 ] to obtain image mask information. The training process follows our four-stage training strategy described in Section III-D2 , with the following iteration schedule: we start with geometric initialization for 2,500 iterations. This is followed by the first level of training for 5,000 iterations, then a coarse-to-fine stage for 10,000 iterations divided into 4 levels with 2,500 iterations per level, and finally, the finest level training for 20,000 iterations. In total, the training comprises 37,500 iterations. All experiments are conducted on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (40GB), taking approximately 40 minutes for training (excluding pose estimation and data preprocessing time). After training, we extract the final model using the Marching Cubes algorithm [ 54 ] with a resolution of 1024.

paragraphs.en: Sampling Strategy. Following the sampling strategy proposed in [ 77 ] , we employ two rounds of proposal sampling and one NeRF sampling, with sample counts of 256, 96, and 24, respectively. More specifically, the final rendering is determined by the 24 sampling points from the NeRF sampling. Notably, to focus on object-level reconstruction, we do not perform sampling along the ray path from its origin until it intersects with the axis-aligned bounding box.

paragraphs.en: DTU Dataset. As shown in Table II , our proposed method achieves the best performance on most scenes and the best average Chamfer distance among all compared methods, demonstrating strong generalization across scenes with both reflective and non-reflective surfaces. The comparison comprises neural implicit methods (e.g., NeuS [ 3 ] , UniSDF [ 5 ] ) and recent 3D Gaussian Splatting based methods (SuGaR [ 45 ] , 2DGS [ 43 ] , GOF [ 46 ] , Rade-GS [ 47 ] , GSDF [ 74 ] ). Optimization time in the table ranges from ∼ \sim 0.5 h to 16 h per scene: several 3DGS methods require less time (e.g., ∼ \sim 0.5 h), while some neural implicit methods require over 16 h. Our method takes ∼ \sim 1 h per scene and attains the best mean Chamfer distance, offering a favorable trade-off between efficiency and accuracy. paragraphs.en: Component-wise Analysis of Color Modeling. Compared to the color network configuration in UniSDF [ 5 ] , our approach introduces three key modifications: ( i ) Incorporating the reflection direction (RD) as input to the Vanilla MLP; ( ii ) Introducing microfacet sampling (MS) during training, and ( iii ) Utilizing a detection-based specular score (DC) as the color blending weight between the vanilla and specular branches. To investigate their individual and combined effects of these components, we start from a baseline configuration that excludes all three components and gradually add each one.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative results on the DTU dataset are presented in Table IV , showing the contributions of each component via Chamfer Distance (CD, lower is better). paragraphs.en: Effect of Specular Blending Weights. To further quantify the impact of specular blending weights on reconstruction performance, we conduct an ablation study on the Shiny Blender dataset and DTU dataset by varying how these weights are defined. We compare four specular blending weight configurations: “Stable” (StableDelight detection scores directly), “All Ones” (all pixels treated as specular), “All Zeros” (all pixels treated as diffuse), and “MLP” (blending weights learned via an auxiliary MLP as in UniSDF [ 5 ] ).

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table V , on Shiny Blender, which predominantly contains reflective materials, “All Ones” achieves the best performance (mean MAE 4.58 ∘ , mean ACC 0.61), consistent with the dataset statistics. “Stable” performs relatively worse (mean MAE 5.37 ∘ ). However, even under this unsuitable prior, the model remains stable and competitive with other state-of-the-art methods (MAE ranks the top three, ACC remains the best as shown in Table III ), indicating that the framework does not collapse under imperfect specular guidance. Qualitatively (Fig. 9 ), the advantage of stronger specular emphasis (“All Ones”) is particularly evident in near-field reflection regions (e.g., Toaster as shown in the 7th row 7th column of Fig. 9 ), whereas “Stable” underestimates reflective confidence in certain scenes (e.g., Coffee, as shown in 7th row 4th column of Fig. 9 ), leading to less accurate normal reconstruction. The “MLP” configuration yields balanced performance but does not fully match the reflective-only prior in highly specular regions. As shown in Table VI , on DTU, which contains mixed reflective and non-reflective materials, “Stable” achieves the best mean Chamfer Distance (0.607), outperforming fixed priors (“All Ones”: 0.65; “All Zeros”: 0.63) and learned blending (“MLP”: 0.615). paragraphs.en: Effect of Microfacet Normal Consistency Loss. The microfacet normal consistency loss (MNCL) enforces the alignment between microfacet normals and local surface normals in specular regions (as detailed in Section III-B3 and Eq. 7.), reflecting the core principle of microfacet theory. To isolate the impact of this loss term, we ablate it while keeping the full configuration (MS, RD, DC as shown in Table IV ). As shown in Table VII , removing MNCL degrades performance by 7.08% (CD 0.65). This demonstrates that the consistency loss plays a crucial role in maintaining physically plausible surface orientations, which directly benefits the reconstruction quality.
paragraphs.zh: 微面法线一致性损失的影响。 微面法线一致性损失（MNCL）强制要求微面法线与局部表面法线在镜面区域保持一致（如第三节 B3 部分和公式 7 所述），这体现了微面理论的核心原则。 为了单独分析该损失项的影响，我们在保持完整配置（如表 IV 所示的 MS、RD 和 DC）不变的情况下进行了消融实验。 如表 VII 所示，移除 MNCL 会使性能下降 7.08%（CD 0.65）。 这表明一致性损失在维持物理上合理的表面方向方面起着关键作用，从而直接提升了重建质量。

paragraphs.en: On the Use of Diffuse v.s. Original Images in the Vanilla branch. To evaluate the suitability of using diffuse images as input for the vanilla branch of our dual-branch color network, we conducted a comparative experiment with two types of input: diffuse images and original images. As shown in Fig. 10 , although directly employing diffuse images for reconstruction may intuitively seem appropriate for modeling diffuse reflectance, our results reveal that they significantly limit reconstruction quality. Specifically, using diffuse images leads to a substantial loss of detail, which in turn compromises the geometric fidelity of the reconstructed models. This results in degraded reconstructions, particularly in fine structural features, such as the blade edges of the scissors and the helical patterns of the screwdriver in DTU scan 37, as well as the intricate details of the buddha statue in the “gardensphere” scene. In these cases, the loss of surface detail significantly impacts reconstruction quality. Quantitatively, as shown in Table IX , the CD metric drops from 0.81 to 0.65 between (b) and (d), and from 0.72 to 0.61 between (f) and Ours, further confirming the adverse effect of using diffuse images directly.
paragraphs.zh: 漫射图像与原始图像的使用对比 Vanilla 分支中的原始图像。 为了评估将漫射图像用作我们双分支色彩网络 Vanilla 分支输入是否合适，我们对两种类型的输入进行了比较实验：漫射图像和原始图像。 如图 10 所示，尽管直接使用漫射图像进行重建在直觉上似乎适合模拟漫射反射，但我们的结果表明，这种做法会显著限制重建质量。 具体来说，使用漫射图像会导致细节严重丢失，进而影响重建模型的几何保真度。 这导致重建结果质量下降，尤其是在精细结构特征方面，例如 DTU 扫描 37 中剪刀的刀刃边缘和螺丝刀的螺旋纹路，以及“gardensphere”场景中佛陀雕像的复杂细节。 在这些情况下，表面细节的丢失对重建质量产生了显著影响。 从量化角度来看，如表 IX 所示，CD 指标在 (b) 和 (d) 之间从 0.81 降至 0.65，在 (f) 和“Ours”之间从 0.72 降至 0.61，进一步证实了直接使用漫射图像的负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Geometry Initialization Strategies. To evaluate the impact of initialization points on reconstruction results, we consider using initialization points from different sources. Specifically, we conduct experiments on the DTU dataset, comparing two initialization strategies: using sparse initialization points and using dense initialization points. The sparse initialization points are byproducts obtained during COLMAP’s camera pose estimation, requiring no additional processing. However, the resulting point cloud is unevenly distributed and of limited quality. In contrast, dense initialization points are generated using downsampled image sets by OpenMVS [ 68 ] , which, while requiring more computational overhead compared to COLMAP, still represents a relatively small portion of the overall reconstruction process (approximately a few minutes). We utilize traditional 3D reconstruction results as the starting point for first-stage geometric initialization. To minimize the potential influence of initialization results on subsequent performance, we release the constraints of dense input points during the following three stages. The quantitative comparison results with OpenMVS are shown in Table VIII . Our method consistently outperforms OpenMVS across all scenes except for DTU scan 55, where OpenMVS reports a slightly better metric score. However, as illustrated in Fig. 11 , our method produces visibly superior results on this scene, with significantly better preservation of fine details and surface quality. As shown in Fig. 12 , the reconstruction results using dense initialization appear significantly smoother compared to those using sparse initialization, especially in regions with darker colors. This conclusion is further validated in Table IX ; for example, the CD metric improved from 0.67 (d) to 0.61 (Ours).

paragraphs.en: Effect of Microfacet Normal Scale. We evaluate the performance of microfacet normals at different scales under both sparse and dense input conditions, as shown in Table IX . In our setting, the initial level is 8 and the finest level is 16. We compare two scale choices. “cur+4” denotes a scale 4 levels finer than the current level, and “cur+8” denotes 8 levels finer, i.e. the finest granularity, corresponding to directly sampling microfacet normals at level 16. Under dense input, switching from the finest scale to “cur+4” improves CD from 0.62 in row (e) to 0.61 in Ours. Under sparse input, the same switch from “cur+8” to “cur+4” improves CD from 0.79 in row (a) to 0.65 in row (d), a larger gain than in the dense case. In both conditions, “cur+4” outperforms the finest scale “cur+8”. This suggests that using the finest grid scale is not necessarily optimal, which is particularly evident when the geometry initialization is sparse, where overly fine scales may amplify noise or lead to unstable normal estimation.

sents.zh: 我们比较了两种比例尺选择。“cur+4”表示比当前层级精细 4 个层级的比例尺，“cur+8”则表示精细 8 个层级，即最精细的粒度，对应于直接在层级 16 上采样微面法线。

sents.en: Under dense input, switching from the finest scale to “cur+4” improves CD from 0.62 in row (e) to 0.61 in Ours.
sents.zh: 在密集输入条件下，从最精细比例尺切换到“cur+4”，CD 值从第 (e) 行的 0.62 提升至“Ours”中的 0.61。

sents.en: Under sparse input, the same switch from “cur+8” to “cur+4” improves CD from 0.79 in row (a) to 0.65 in row (d), a larger gain than in the dense case.
sents.zh: 在稀疏输入条件下，同样从“cur+8”切换到“cur+4”，CD 值从第 (a) 行的 0.79 提升至第 (d) 行的 0.65，这一提升幅度大于密集输入的情况。

sents.en: In both conditions, “cur+4” outperforms the finest scale “cur+8”.
sents.zh: 在这两种条件下，“cur+4”的表现均优于最精细比例尺“cur+8”。

sents.en: This suggests that using the finest grid scale is not necessarily optimal, which is particularly evident when the geometry initialization is sparse, where overly fine scales may amplify noise or lead to unstable normal estimation.
sents.zh: 这表明使用最精细的网格比例尺并不一定是最优选择，尤其在几何初始化稀疏时这一点尤为明显，因为过于精细的比例尺可能会放大噪声或导致法线估计不稳定。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented MicroSDF, a novel framework for 3D reconstruction of scenes with both reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Grounded in physical principles, MicroSDF integrates microfacet theory to guide both geometric and color modeling. Specifically, we introduce a microfacet consistency loss to enforce physically meaningful surface geometry for reflective regions, while leveraging microfacet normals to facilitate specular color learning. This is further enhanced by a detection-guided color blending strategy, which provides external supervision for physically plausible color modeling. Together, these components enable our framework to effectively handle both reflective and non-reflective surfaces in a unified manner.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 MicroSDF——一个用于同时重建反射和非反射表面的场景的三维重建新框架。 MicroSDF 基于物理原理，整合了微面理论以指导几何和颜色建模。 具体来说，我们引入了一种微面一致性损失函数，以强制反射区域具有物理上合理的表面几何结构，同时利用微面法线来促进镜面颜色的学习。 此外，一种检测引导的颜色混合策略进一步提升了效果，该策略为物理上可信的颜色建模提供了外部监督。 这些组件共同使我们的框架能够以统一的方式有效处理反射和非反射表面。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness and robustness of our framework. On the DTU dataset, which mixes reflective and non-reflective surfaces, MicroSDF achieves state-of-the-art performance with an average Chamfer Distance of 0.61, outperforming existing methods. On the synthetic reflective Shiny Blender benchmark, our method also attains state-of-the-art quantitative results, demonstrating its strong capability in handling highly specular scenes. For real-world reflective datasets such as Ref-NeRF and DeepVoxels, we provide qualitative evaluations that show high-fidelity reconstruction of reflective regions and improved surface consistency. These results indicate that MicroSDF generalizes well across both controlled synthetic environments and real-world scenarios. Moreover, the proposed integration of microfacet-driven priors offers a principled way to incorporate physically grounded reflectance modeling into neural reconstruction frameworks. This idea is potentially compatible with recent 3D Gaussian Splatting approaches for improved reconstruction of reflective and specular surfaces, which we consider a promising direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 在多种基准数据集上进行的广泛实验验证了我们框架的有效性和鲁棒性。 在混合了反射面和非反射面的 DTU 数据集上，MicroSDF 以平均 0.61 的切姆弗距离实现了当前最优性能，优于现有方法。 在合成反射场景 Shiny Blender 基准数据集上，我们的方法也取得了当前最优的定量结果，证明了其处理高镜面反射场景的强大能力。 对于 Ref-NeRF 和 DeepVoxels 等真实世界的反射数据集，我们提供了定性评估，结果显示了反射区域的高保真重建以及更优的表面一致性。 这些结果表明，MicroSDF 在受控的合成环境与真实世界场景中均能良好泛化。 此外，所提出的微面驱动先验的整合方法，为将基于物理的反射率建模纳入神经重建框架提供了一种理论依据明确的方式。 这一思路可能与近期的 3D 高斯泼溅技术兼容，从而提升对反射和镜面表面的重建效果，我们认为这是未来研究的一个有前景方向。
